raw_translation: 簡單住宅購買的簡化估算,採用10月ZXQPH0000QXZ日檢查的公佈稅率。 該稅率不包括租賃、混合用途物業、公司/信託規則、連結購買和特殊減免。 資格取決於所有買家和交易細節。 稅率可能會發生變化;在採取行動之前,請與連結稅務機關核實估算。
source: A simplified estimate for a straightforward residential purchase, using published rates checked on 19 October 2026. It excludes leases, mixed-use property, company/trust rules, linked purchases and special reliefs. Eligibility depends on all buyers and transaction details. Rates can change; verify the estimate with the linked tax authority before acting. Your inputs stay in this browser and are not sent to UsefulVerse.

raw_translation: 所有稅率均為您輸入的估計值。 該計算器不確定應納稅基數、按比例處理、稅級、州稅、提前提款罰金、醫療保險效果或資格。 IRA以外支付的稅收有機會成本,不包括在顯示的賬戶餘額中。 請與國稅局或合格的稅務專業人士確認當前的稅收規則。
source: All rates are estimates you enter. This calculator does not determine taxable basis, pro-rata treatment, tax brackets, state tax, early-withdrawal penalties, Medicare effects or eligibility. Tax paid outside the IRA has an opportunity cost that is not included in the displayed account balance. Confirm current tax rules with the IRS or a qualified tax professional.
